name: xAI (Grok)
notes: xAI ships both sides: the `grok` harness entry is Grok Build, this one is the model side. XAI_API_KEY is what Grok Build authenticates with outside a browser and what any OpenAI-compatible harness pointed at api.x.ai uses, so the key identifies the vendor rather than the tool — which is exactly the split between Waypost-Harness and Waypost-Provider.
